io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.menus

Class AddonMenuRegistry

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.menus.AddonMenuRegistry

  • public final class AddonMenuRegistry
extends java.lang.Object
    Which addons declared their own guide menu, and which were folded into one by the guide.

    An addon gets exactly one entry in the classic layout. It can shape that entry itself by declaring a root here; otherwise the guide builds one around whatever top-level groups the addon registered, which is what keeps the rule true for addons that never migrate (including third-party ones).

    See Also:

      • recordAutoWrapped

        public void recordAutoWrapped(@Nonnull
                              java.lang.String addon,
                              int groupCount)
        Records that the guide built an addon's menu for it. Reported by #reportBuiltMenus() once the whole pass is done, not here: menus are folded one addon at a time, so logging per addon reprinted the growing list on every step.
        Parameters:
        addon - The addon that was folded
        groupCount - How many top-level groups it registered

      • getAutoWrappedAddons

        @Nonnull
public java.util.Set<java.lang.String> getAutoWrappedAddons()
        The addons whose menu the guide built, rather than the addon declaring one.
        Implementation Note:
        Not logged. Folding is the standard path, the menu is named by the addon and iconed from the installer catalog either way, so there is nothing for an addon author to act on - the line was pure boot noise. Kept as state so a declared root still takes precedence and so this stays answerable if it is ever wanted.
